name: Straelen (Germany)
description: Horizontal tricolour of black, white and green in the proportions 1:2:1, charged at the centre with the black arrow-like house mark of the city arms of Straelen.
history: Municipal flag of Straelen; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: arrow-like house mark from the city arms
